entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5981406000300438016: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2293.8 +/- 205.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2293.8 +/- 205.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3175 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 0.89), 15.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.891, -2.806 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 5981406000300438016 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 73 +/- 6.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 73 +/- 6.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5000 +/- 204 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 183, Name='TW Nor', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5000 +/- 204 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,000 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 1.157 +/- 0.013 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe6d0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,000 K and log g 1.4 (u1 0.622, u2 0.146): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1.4 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 4 spectra; the 10 published values span log g 0.8 to 2.02, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.9% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 5981406000300438016: 6 G-band harmonics of a 10.787024878598144 d period, peak-to-peak 0.644 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.
